title: unified-rollouts-add-safety-guards-and-observability-for-canary-ab-shadow-autorollback
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: production canary + A/B + shadow rollouts need stronger safety guards and better telemetry so autorollback decisions are observable and debuggable. This PR implements (1) a quarantine state for canary/probing stages to avoid noisy transient metrics triggering rollbacks, (2) quorum-based metric aggregation across probe shards before a rollback decision is taken, (3) explicit telemetry events and traces for autorollback decisions (decision_reason, contributing_metrics, thresholds), and (4) a set of e2e stability guards and unit tests to reduce flakiness. Changes are designed to be backward-compatible with existing rollout configs; new guards are opt-in via rollout.spec.safetyGuards and rollout.spec.observabilityAnnotations. High level changes: rollout controller: add quarantine lifecycle, metric-quorum evaluator, and decision tracing hooks; autorollback engine: make decision evaluation idempotent and tolerant to partial metric feeds, introduce rate-limited quiesce window after a rollback to avoid oscillation; observability: new metrics (rollout_quarantine_count, autorollback_decision_total{outcome,reason}), traces for decision paths, and per-rollout decision logs sent to event sink; e2e: add stability test harness that replays historical noisy metrics to validate guards. Checklist: [x] design doc updated (Linear ENG-7842), [x] unit tests, [x] integration tests, [x] e2e stability harness, [x] docs and changelog entry. Backwards compatibility: default behavior unchanged; features behind opt-in flags in rollout spec. Rollout plan: gradual rollout to staging, run probe harness for 48h, then promote to production with canary=5% for 2h, quorum enabled. Known limitations: per-customer metric cardinality could increase; follow-up (ENG-7901) will add aggregation sampling. Related PRs/contexts: builds on previous autorollback refactor PR-816544 and several observability PRs (pr-82901, pr-91234).

review_comments: Jordan Lee: Can we add a short-circuit to skip quorum if the metric window is complete? Concerned about latency in small canaries.
Aisha Patel: Added a short-circuit check in quorum.go that returns early when sample_count >= min_samples and all shards reported; added unit test to validate behavior.
Kai Martinez: Request to surface the exact metric values that triggered the rollback in the decision log. Helps post-mortem analysis.
Aisha Patel: Decision payload now includes contributing_metrics as a serialized map in the event sink; kept payload size bounded with sampling and top-k metrics.
Sana Gupta: Tests look flakey on e2e CI run 2 (timeout in replay harness). Can we increase tolerances or make retries deterministic?
Aisha Patel: Increased harness timeouts and added deterministic seed for replay; re-ran e2e and CI passed.
Jordan Lee: Approval after address comments. Left one nit about inline comment formatting in docs.
Kai Martinez: Approved. Observability additions LGTM; please ensure we add alerts for autorollback rate on staging.

Release Manager (internal note): merge when green and after 48h staging validation.
release_notes: Added opt-in safety guards for canary/AB/shadow autorollbacks: quarantine stage, metric quorum evaluation, richer decision telemetry; e2e stability harness for rollout workflows.
